title: [Pre Order, PS5] Grand Theft Auto VI Standard Edition (Download Code in Box, USA PSN Region Only) $107.58 Delivered @ KEYEKEY
body:
Deal: [Pre Order, PS5] Grand Theft Auto VI Standard Edition (Download Code in Box, USA PSN Region Only) $107.58 Delivered @ KEYEKEY

[DMFD] Ha! Pre order an unlimited amount of CD keys. How about some physical media for a preorder and a book and a map of the area.
Dont buy in to it. Dont let them forget what they took from us.
[Mortgagetightass] Whilst I agree with you, this game is very likely the best selling game of the year already on pre-orders alone.
[tanksinatra] Then they won't mind me holding out for the physical copy.
[edfoo] Pre-order physical copy of the game is fine. Pre-order digital copy is dumb.
[krisspy] Through official channels.
Using stolen credit cards
[tonyjzx] How do KEYEKEY get their game keys?
GOOD: Through official channels.
BAD: Using stolen credit cards
[Magical Sound Shower] Wait for gift cards to go on sale and pre-order it from JB for almost the same price ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
edit: and you won’t have to faff around with US PSN accounts for purchasing compatible DLC too.
[Roe Jogan] has anyone noticed that there is no ultimate edition pre order so far from any major retailer. why?
[Merlict] It doesn't exist.
You can upgrade to Ultimate on the digital store.
[Roe Jogan] is that how it is for worldwide or only aus?
[Merlict] Seems to be worldwide but didn't look that hard.
[Frackingiscool] I just did a quick search on Google about keyekey.
I'd suggest any prospective buyers to do the same and weigh up the cons and cons of using them.
[Merlict] Yeah the risk doesn't seem worth it for minimal saving
[pichxlonco] Never understood the appeal of GTA or why people go so crazy for it as to post so much for a cdkey. Is it that good? I think i tried playing IV a bit a few years ago but all the initial missions felt the same.
[Frackingiscool] Ours is not to reason why,
Ours is but to read and buy.
[Larsson] The new Ozbargain motto? Fits very well.
[StephenCurry] I think it let u commit crimes that usually not permitted irl. And it feels real.
[Frackingiscool] "usually not permitted" is a weird concept of crime.
I mean I get your point though, it's crime in game with no consequence in reality.
Not like "murder is usually not permitted but this one time, at band camp"
[StephenCurry] Haha yea I should've said things usually not permitted irl, mostly crimes. Cuz I remember a clip where Anthony Davis kidnapped then executed Stephen curry in GTA. Feels funny tho.
[krisspy] Played the top down gtas up to vice city. It was fun back then and even with the nostalgia I've never really cared for the newer gta games.
[Fooah] Even the most popular and enjoyed media will have people who simply dont enjoy or engage with it.
You might just be somebody who doesnt like the genre or format of the GTA games. Thats perfectly ok.
[smartazz104] Do you also question why games like Minecraft and Call of Duty are popular too?
[He-Mania] I've very much enjoyed all the GTA games from vice city onwards. I'm very annoyed at the 6 price and no disc…. but probably will get it anyways.
But tell you what - the SCARFACE GTA clone game, for its time, was better than GTA vice city
[hollykryten] Why buy a redemption code that can only be redeemed on a United States PSN account?. I don't think many Australians are going to have that.
[TheDukeOfNukem] All for saving a few dollars, but if Costco is 115, if JB/BigW are both 125 (and have $10 coupons each, so 115 easily enough). Hell, you might get away with matching Costco at JB and then using the tenner to make it 105.
But anyway, if 115 is pretty attainable, and I say this as someone who frequently uses code sites, maybe pay the 7 or so extra dollars and get a code that
Will be available at the start of the preload period (because if it's a physically shipped code, and it's American, good luck getting it on time)
Will work on your Aussie account (because unlike Xbox or Nintendo, you can't easily swap regions on PSN)
Is actually guaranteed to work (because sites like this have a big ol' history of being sketchy)
This deal just ain't it for me, dawg.
[AEKaBeer] I don't know how true any of this is, but I saw a video where they say that none of the writers from the previous games worked in this game and that you should wait for reviews before buying it.
[King Steuart] you should wait for reviews before buying it.
I mean when there's no incentive to preorder, this is pretty obvious.
[smartazz104] I’m sure there are many people out there who can write a story for a GTA game.
[Pinchy] The writing was good, but the gameplay is the best part of GTA. I don't think they have made a bad GTA yet..
[XVX] Managed to score a pre-order for $70 the other day. I think that is quite reasonable given that it's just long term renting of a digital licence that will eventually disappear.
[King Steuart] Usually when someone says this, they've traded something in
[topherboi] Surely @XVX will be back to confirm…..right?
[hollykryten] And why a code which can only be redeemed onto a United States PSN account. What good is that to the majority of Australians.
[Headless] Many have discovered digital things are significantly cheaper in the US than here
[topherboi] Why would anyone start smoking knowing the consequences?
[Laziofogna] Am I wrong in wanting to wait and purchase the game including a disc?
[smartazz104] Of course not, but they aren’t putting this on disc.
[SirFrankGrimes] They’re ceasing all disc production by 2028
[emblurr] You can get the standard version for $87 and Deluxe for $110 off the Japanese PSN store. No need for dodgy key sites.
[HaydosK] How does it work for playstation accounts? Do you need a whole new account?
[Helioze] Read somewhere that apparently the standard edition doesn't include multiplayer. I don't know if this true, but there is also talk of uploading I.D to prove you are of age in order to play the video game.
[KKKE] Yes, GTA 6 is a “single-player experience”
[darthsparrow] LOL, no disc no buy.
Also, insert mandatory footer below:
Play Has No Limits
[HaydosK] Play Has No Limits Unless You Don't Have Internet
[darthsparrow] Until the agreement with our suppliers expire and we remove the stuff that you "bought" from that said supplier.
Signed,
Play Has No Limits
[eggaz] Needs to be tied to a US PSN account, forget it.
[eggaz] I can't wait to "buy" this game. If buying isn't owing, piracy isn't stealing.
[cook99] Hard no for digital only downloads. Wish all the simps would not pre-order to send the right message…
